name: Juneda (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow eradicated tree, with two yellow diagonal bars at the upper hoist and lower fly corners.
history: The official flag of Juneda is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the yellow eradicated tree of the arms, 13/20 of the height and 7/30 of the length of the cloth, at the centre, and two yellow bars; approved on 21 May 2008 and published in the DOGC on 5 June 2008.

features.role: bar cutting the upper hoist corner
bar cutting the lower fly corner
